title: The Space email acceptable-use policy is live: indexed, dated, linked from the Turn on email card and the Terms, with the draft framing gone

source.ref: Owner ruling on OWN-085, 2026-09-30: "Ship without counsel review"; the draft is LIVE-707 (#3066, ADR-1658); ADR-1673

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1673). OWNER RULING on OWN-085 (2026-09-30): "Ship without counsel review" for the Space email acceptable-use policy. RE-TESTED FIRST (ADR-1082) on main at f7f7d3075: app/space-email-policy/page.tsx was the LIVE-707 draft, robots noindex/nofollow, absent from app/sitemap.ts, linked from nowhere (the Turn on email card only named it in a comment), opening with "DRAFT. Not in force, and no lawyer has read it yet.", closing with eleven questions for counsel, and carrying one bracketed placeholder (the appeal reply time). The LIVE-707 design (ADR-1658 decision 6) said going live means removing the banner and the questions, letting the page be indexed and sitemapped, and linking it from the Turn on email card; it specified no new acceptance step (acceptance by name was one of the questions for counsel, not a decision).

WHAT SHIPPED. (1) The page is Frequency's policy: the draft banner, the eyebrow and the questions for counsel are gone; it reads "Last updated: September 30, 2026"; metadata is robots index, follow with its own openGraph and twitter blocks like /privacy and /terms; app/sitemap.ts lists it beside them. (2) Copy that was draft-only is settled without inventing a commitment: the prohibited list says "We may add to this list" instead of "a draft for review"; the appeal placeholder is replaced by "A person reads every appeal and writes back" (no reply time is promised, since the owner set none). (3) Two facts that shipped after the draft are stated because the code now keeps them: every email ends with Frequency Labs Holdings' postal address (LIVE-728, lib/email-studio/postal.ts) and a suspended Space sends no email at all (LIVE-727, spaceEmailHold). (4) components/spaces/email/email-enable-card.tsx links the policy above its checkbox ("Read the Space email policy before you turn it on"), opening in a new tab so the card keeps its state. The checkbox, its words, and setSpaceEmailEnabled are unchanged: no new consent flow, nothing new recorded, no migration. (5) Section 4 of app/terms/page.tsx points a Space that sends email at the policy, and its Last updated moves to September 30, 2026. (6) docs/CHANGELOG.md gains a line. LIVE-707's probe asserted the hidden-draft state, so its fragment is amended in this PR to measure what still holds (the page, its sections, no dash, the cap and the complaint line read from the code). OWN-085 is left to its own PR.

TESTS: app/space-email-policy/page.test.tsx (indexed and sitemapped, dated, none of the draft framing, linked from the card and the Terms, no dash, and the cap, the complaint line, the admin default, the postal line, the suspension hold and the import consent state each read from the module that keeps them); components/spaces/email/email-enable-card.test.tsx (new: the card renders a link to /space-email-policy, one checkbox with the same words, and Turn on email disabled until it is ticked).

verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1673). In-process, reads source with comments stripped. Fails on main at f7f7d3075 at the first arm (the Turn on email card does not link the policy). Arms: the card links /space-email-policy (literal href, or a Link whose href is the const holding it); the card still has exactly one Checkbox with the unchanged acknowledgment label (no new consent step); the page declares robots index true, follow true; the page carries none of the draft framing (DRAFT, Draft for counsel, draft for review, Not in force, no lawyer has read it, For counsel, [owner to set); it reads Last updated: September 30, 2026; no em or en dash; app/sitemap.ts lists ${SITE_URL}/space-email-policy; app/terms/page.tsx links it. Each arm mutation-fired (noindex, a DRAFT banner, the date gone, an em dash, the sitemap line gone, the Terms link gone, the card link gone, the checkbox label changed). Exits 79 only when the card, the Terms or the sitemap file is gone.
